name: claims-frozen-2026-10-01
provenance: Written and labelled on 2026-10-01 by the same author (an AI assistant) who maintains the classifier, BEFORE the classifier was run on any of it, and committed before the first run. It must never be used to change the classifier: a miss here is reported, not fixed. It is partially informed (its author has seen the classifier's patterns), so it is not a blind test.

labels.non_receipt: the parcel or service never arrived
labels.duplicate: the same purchase was charged more than once
labels.cancellation: the order was cancelled and still charged
labels.unauthorized: the cardholder did not make or allow the purchase
labels.in_transit: the parcel is late or still on its way
labels.abstain: hedged, underspecified or mixed: a human should read it
labels.non_claim: a message that asserts no disputable problem
